details:
This bug happens consistently to my friend and others who currently have 1 Vive controller, here is a description of the bug:

1. Open VRChat with 1 Vive controller

2. Load into an avatar that features a radial slider from 0%-100% (Or something like it)

3. Click the option, in this case we will suppose a "Hue slider", for clarity

4. The wheel has now appeared and they may attempt to adjust the value (With the same touchpad they use to walk)

5. Errors begin below

6. The user is forced to walk whilst adjusting the slider in any said direction, turn it to 0%/100%, you walk forwards, 50% you walk backwards, etc

7. The user cannot exit this radial menu through the typical means such as the trigger

7a. The user may only escape by switching avatars, where they may then also switch back to their previous one to continue using it

As far as I can tell this is something that happens to anyone and everyone when they turn off their other Vive controller, however I also must mention, this has been primarily tested with only having the RIGHT controller turned on and the left turned off, this could be quite important(?)

So to be clear, the issues I detect are:

>User movement not disabled when using radial wheel sliders with only one (Right?) Vive controller connected

>User cannot exit radial menu sliders with only one (Right???) Vive controller connected

These bug(s?) seem to be relatively recent, perhaps in the last 3 months or so as I can recall.

I apologize for some accounts of vagueness and uncertainty here, and also perhaps skirting the edge of "Don't report more than 1 issue at once", to me it feels these issues are very linked to each other.

Cheers!
title: One handed Radial wheel slider stuck
